critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1314 lines (was 1043) — still growing; strongly recommend extracting routers (brand_router.py, admin_router.py, public_router.py), models.py, auth.py, ai_service.py.
BrandForm 'about' uses FormTextarea with label='' inside a FormSection — title is on the section. Works visually but consider passing label='Firmanın ne iş yaptığı' for screen-reader users.

Password change endpoint compares brand.portal_password == payload.current_password in plain text (matches PRD admin-visible requirement). This is intentional but should be documented in code comment alongside the comparison to deter future devs from 'fixing' it with hashing.

BrandSelfUpdate has no explicit allow-list constraint on logo_position — server happily saves any string. Consider Enum/Literal['top-left',...,'bottom-right'] on logo_position to prevent typos from breaking generation. Same for brand_color (could validate '#RRGGBB' regex).
POST /api/brand/upload returns absolute path '/api/uploads/...' which is good; ensure UPLOAD_DIR is mounted on a persistent volume in prod (not container ephemeral fs).

BrandSettingsModal handles password state separately from form state (good). Consider clearing password fields after successful change for security (currently they retain the just-typed new password).
data-testids on the 9-grid pos buttons match the backend logo_position keys (settings-pos-center, etc.) — clean mapping.
